roles.owner: canonical workbook routed by the TOC; changes can drive the model
roles.routing: IGNITION Table of Contents; decides which workbook owns a fact
roles.reference: WORKING/non-canon or narrative/visual reference; changes are reported, never implemented automatically

seeded.note: A baseline older than reviewed_modified_utc is stale: the next run re-exports it, and changed cells inside reviewed_ranges are marked covered_by_review. IGNITION files modified before reviewed_at_utc were visible to that review and are not reported as new.
